out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2025 health department permit was posted but the 2026 permit was not.
violations.corrective_action: Locate and post the 2026 health department permit in a conspicuous location as soon as possible.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The PIC moved the wet wiping cloth to a properly mixed sanitizing solution during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored with the handles up or lined up to prevent hand contact with lip contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.
